_how: Real testimonials only, quoted word for word. Add one, then run: python3 scripts/build_testimonials.py  (rebuilds the list on /reviews). topic: promotions | consulting | coaching. source (optional): e.g. LinkedIn recommendation | YouTube comment. source_url optional (link to the original). date optional (YYYY-MM-DD). Optional per testimonial: highlight (exact phrase from the quote, shown bold), logo (/logos/...). featured: a short exact excerpt shown large at the top. themes: recurring points, each listing the names whose testimonials say it, with an exact quote as evidence.

testimonials.quote: I have known Kajol since the beginning of her career as an analyst when she helped build our Connected Retail proposition. She is extremely passionate, driven and delivers great results consistently. I have to say that she is one of the best people I have worked with and you won’t find 2 people like her. She is now a key leader in Customer Strategy and Product both in terms of craft and driving business. She is also a great coach and mentor for those working in her teams. There are not many people who can manage as much as she does with so much passion and dedication, as well as be such a pleasure to be around.
testimonials.name: Melissa Smith
testimonials.role: Chief Strategy Officer, ex-Deloitte · managed Kajol directly
testimonials.highlight: one of the best people I have worked with and you won’t find 2 people like her

testimonials.quote: I worked closely with Kajol on a recent client engagement and genuinely don't know what we would have done without her. She has a great natural ability for building relationships and a really positive attitude towards new challenges. We benefitted massively from her creativity and problem solving plus she is great at coaching other team members. I think Kajol would be a fantastic asset to any team or project and hope we get more opportunities to work together in the future.

testimonials.quote: Kajol is one of the most enthusiastic and dedicated individuals I have worked with in Deloitte. She is extremely diligent, hardworking and a pleasure to work with. She has produced high quality outputs in her work at clients with Digital Strategy and I have seen her grow and learn through this opportunity. I have also observed her interacting with clients in the Connected Store and she is confident, friendly and knowledgeable. One of Kajol’s greatest strengths is her ability to quickly build rapport and relationships with clients and internal stakeholders – this is an asset which I believe will make her successful in whatever she does but especially in client interactions. … Overall, I am proud to have Kajol in my team …
